prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and close each writer, then clear the dict; and call `terminate()` on all active sessions in the manager's `lifespan` finally-block before cancelling tasks. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and close each writer, then clear the dict; and call `terminate()` on all active sessions in the manager's `lifespan` finally-block before cancelling tasks. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it contains identical SSE-writer-closing logic in `terminate()` plus an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) that prevents double-termination if `terminate()` is called concurrently. PR #2253 wraps the writer-close loop in `# pragma: no cover` without the guard, leaving a latent re-entrancy bug.
